'''Point Rain''' was the name that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] gave to its main [[Staging area/Legends|staging area]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Point Rain" /> It was located a short distance from the [[Ray shield generator/Legends|ray shield generator]] that was protecting [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|battle droid factories]]. It was a heavily bombarded landing point, and only [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] forces had made it, but his gunship had been shot down and he was seriously injured.<ref name="Point Rain" />
